_comment: Windows packaging default engine overrides, applied by WhisperDictate.spec
staged for the build. Keys are the profile's current model; values replace
the engine/model/model_revision keys of matching profiles. Measured parity
(2026-10-07, .parity-scratch corpus): EN real WER 4.88% (parakeet f16 GGUF)
vs 7.32% (torch EN), no hotword regressions, GPU decode 4-8x faster. The
DE Nemotron GGUF measured 2.5% word drift vs the torch engine (the GGUF
bakes NeMo's default 240 ms lookahead instead of the 1.12 s setting the
transformers engine uses), so DE deliberately stays on the torch engine.
